For any set $S$, we have $|P(S)|={2}^{|S|}.$ 

In our case, we have $|X|=0.$ Therefore, we obtain

$$
|P(X)|={2}^{0}=1.
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}|P(P(X)))| & ={2}^{|P(X))|} \\  & ={2}^{1} \\  & =2.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we have,

$$
\begin{aligned}|P(P(P(X))| & ={2}^{|P(P(X)|} \\  & ={2}^{2} \\  & =4.\end{aligned}
$$
